name: Fortified Spell (Metamagic)
body:
You can make your spells more effective at overcoming spell resistance.

Benefit(s): You can prepare fortified spells in higher leveled spell slots to gain a bonus on checks to overcome spell resistance. For each spell level above the normal level of the spell you gain a +2 bonus on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance. You cannot choose to fortify a spell which is not normally subject to spell resistance.
